1 N. of the people living
round Gayā and the district
inhabited by them.
--2 N. of an
Asura.
--3 Wealth.
--4 House,
household, family.
--5 Offspring,
progeny.
--6 The sky.
--7 One's own
place or abode.
--या N. of a city
in Behar which is a place of
pilgrimage.

गायः [गै भावे घञ्] Singing, a
song;

गायकः [गै-ण्वुल्]
1 A singer,
musician; न नटा न विटा न गायकाः

1 A Vedic metre of 24
syllables; गायत्री छंदसामहं

.
--2 N. of a very sacred verse
repeated by every Brāhmaṇa at his
Saṃdhyā (morning and evening
devotions) and on other occasions
also. Great sins even are said to be
expiated by a pious repetition of
this verse, which is as follows:
--तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो न
प्रचोदयात्

.
--त्रं A
hymn composed and recited in the
Gāyatrī metre.
--Comp.
--वल्लभः an
epithet of Śiva.

गायत्रिन् a. (णी f.) One who
sings hymns, especially of the
Sāmaveda.

v. l.
--नं Singing, a song.
--2 Practising singing as a means of
subsistence.
